title: What the Vat Kept
markup: Words between *asterisks* are key words: the talk panel shows them in its one accent colour (docs/LEVEL_KIT.md, section 3). Scene ids are the level.json lines keys: a Person with talk_id <id> plays <id>_faded while faded, <id> the first time awake and <id>_again after. Speaker 'narration' is unvoiced text on the panel with no name (who ""). Speaker 'verse' is a verse-stone: four lines, shown when it is bloomed.

pell.name: Pell
pell.voice: Ferry child, paper hat. Quick, practical, never explains the plot.

wenna.name: Wenna
wenna.voice: Kept the kiln's fires for the Ink-maker. Plain, warm, tired; talks while she works.

verse.name: Verse-stone
verse.voice: The Ink-maker's own words, carved and remembered. Four lines each.

scenes.speaker: pell
scenes.trigger: Talk to Pell on the landing (first talk). Phase B may play it on arrival, before control.
lines: End of the river. Well. End of the bit I'll pole.
That's the *kiln* up there, with the round hat on. All the black came down from it.
I'll mind the raft. Shout if you need me. I won't hear you, but shout.

scenes.speaker: pell
scenes.trigger: Talk to Pell again on the landing.
lines: The gate's tied with ink. You're good with knots. Well, you cut them.

scenes.speaker: verse
scenes.trigger: Bloom verse-stone 1 on the landing.
lines: I came up the river with a jar of black
and a fear of every colour going pale.
The mountain gave me clay, the stream gave water.
I built a kiln to make a black that stays.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 6 m of the gate while it is shut. Plays once.
lines: The gate is tied shut with a cord of wet *ink*. The two braziers beside it are cold, their wicks still dry.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: One of the gate's three locks is still on (the cord or either brazier) after the other two are done.
lines: The gate shivers in its frame, and holds.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Talk to Wenna while she is faded (before the yard is restored).
lines: A woman by the woodpile, as grey as the ash in her bucket. She does not look up.

scenes.speaker: wenna
scenes.trigger: The yard is restored (its sapling bloomed after the sealed fight): Wenna wakes, and speaks when Orimi talks to her. Plays once.
lines: Oh. The logs are *brown*. I'd forgotten logs were brown.
I'm Wenna. I kept his fires for twenty winters, till he sent me down to the yard and barred the hall.
The hall floor's gone bad. Keep to the *boards*. Where the soot's buried them, the *bellows* still blow.
The back door hangs on a counterweight. He always *tied* it off to the post. And mind the flue after. It fills.

scenes.speaker: wenna
scenes.trigger: Talk to Wenna again after she wakes.
lines: He wasn't unkind. He was frightened of *grey*.
He'd hold a page up to the window every morning, to see if it had faded in the night.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Orimi steps onto the entry platform P0 inside the hall door. Plays once.
lines: Racks of paper, every sheet grey. The floor between the boards *smoulders* with ink.

scenes.speaker: verse
scenes.trigger: Bloom verse-stone 2 on the hall's entry platform.
lines: Paper fades. The dyer's blue goes grey by spring.
I hung a thousand sheets to dry and watched them.
The ones I inked the deepest held the longest.
So I inked deeper. Then I inked the ink.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Orimi reaches the back aisle strip P3 while the door is shut. Plays once.
lines: The door's weight hangs from a beam overhead. Below it stands a *post*, worn smooth by rope.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Orimi enters the flue (M_FlueEntry). Plays once.
lines: Somewhere below, the ink begins to *rise*.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Orimi has stood on one ledge for 8 s with a lamp above still unlit. Plays once.
lines: Too dark to see the next ledge. The lamps on the walls still have their *wicks*.

scenes.speaker: verse
scenes.trigger: Bloom verse-stone 3 inside the vat chamber door.
lines: The vat drank lamp-black, charcoal, soot and night.
It grew too heavy to stir, and then to lift.
One morning something in the dark looked back.
I told it: keep. It was the only word it learned.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Orimi steps past M_Arena_Entry: the fight seals. Plays once.
lines: Something in the vat breathes out *soot*.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Part 1 has lasted 25 s with no Gust on the veil.
lines: The soot round it *billows* like a curtain in a draught.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Part 2 has lasted 25 s with no arm cut.
lines: Each arm lies *still* a moment after it strikes.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Part 3: the Dregs has reached the top of the chains once.
lines: Each of the two *pillars* carries an iron ring.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: Part 4: the binding has broken once.
lines: Three kiln mouths, cold for years. Their *wicks* are still dry.

scenes.speaker: narration
scenes.trigger: The Dregs has unravelled; Orimi comes within 6 m of the vat. Plays once.
lines: The vat is cracked from rim to foot. Something *green* waits in the crack.

scenes.speaker: verse
scenes.trigger: Bloom verse-stone 4, which the tree's roots lift out of the floor.
lines: It kept the river, the reeds, the faces. It kept them still.
Nothing faded, because nothing moved.
I was wrong about what stays. Colour stays by coming back.
Let the river run. Let it fade, and bloom.

scenes.speaker: pell
scenes.trigger: The raft talk after completion (level.json raft.talk), after verse-stone 4. Pell has followed Orimi up the flue and stands in the chamber door (M_Pell_End) for the first two lines; the camera then rises through the oculus to M_EndView, over the valley in full colour, for the last. The travel card that follows reads "End of Book One."
lines: That flue is a lot of stairs.
So that's where all the colour went. Back where it was.
There's more river above the mountain, you know.
